'''August 2001 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, PA on 11 August 2001. It is known from Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2825">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-lancaster-pa-8-11-01d2825/ lancaster-pa-8-11-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-lancaster-pa-8-11-01d2825/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
